title: Introduce Report struct wrapping rust_report_gen free functions
description: Brownfield Rust migration: encapsulate item analysis functions in a Report struct while keeping backward-compatible free functions.

task_spec.prompt:
Migrate src/lib.rs to introduce a Report struct. All 3 existing tests must still pass.

Add:
  pub struct Report { /* items: Vec<Item> */ }

  impl Report {
    pub fn new(items: Vec<Item>) -> Self

    pub fn sum(&self) -> f64
      — delegates to the package-level sum function

    pub fn max_item(&self) -> Option<&Item>
      — delegates to the package-level max_item function

    pub fn min_item(&self) -> Option<&Item>
      — delegates to the package-level min_item function

    pub fn average(&self) -> Option<f64>
      — returns the average value of all items, or None if empty
  }

Do not modify the existing free functions or tests.
Add at least 4 tests for the Report struct.
All 3 existing tests must still pass.
Run: cargo test
required_artifacts: Report::average returns mean or None for empty
At least 4 tests for Report methods
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test` to verify the migration is correct. Make sure existing behavior is preserved and the migration handles edge cases safely.
Final verification: run `cargo test` and confirm all tests pass. Is this migration safe to run on real data without data loss or breaking existing clients?
